verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that LangGraph performs 'a few basic checks on the structure of your graph (no orphaned nodes, etc.)' at build time, which is a thin form of build-time validation but far short of strict typing/schema validation for catching agent mistakes. Missing for 10: evidence of typed state schemas (e.g., Pydantic/TypedDict validation), compile-time type checking, schema mismatch errors, or any documentation of static analysis catching agent coding errors before runtime.
